answer: Beacon decay blocks bulk fakes. Each agent locks 70 credits; each epoch a falcon probe arrives at random, and the holder has ten minutes for a quill-signed hash within the horizon. A miss, delay, or copy decays the bond by 8; at zero it burns. First probe 32, k-th 32+7(k-1): 1,000 fakes pay 3,528,500, locking 70,000 for a 40,000 pool. Rented falcon rings fail: one operator cannot sign 1,000 quill hashes in ten minutes. Honest agents pay 32 once.
